scale: venue proof (5 jobs, Gemini, batch tier — first third venue to capture)
notes: The first venue outside OpenAI and Anthropic to actually settle at a batch tier. 5/5 ok, zero sync fallbacks, 50.0% captured, 2m36s end to end including polling. Groq (403) and Mistral (402) both gate batch behind a plan; this one was gated too until billing was enabled, and the same probe that returned FAILED_PRECONDITION then returns a validation error now.

Small on purpose. The quote gate prices output at the ceiling, and a reasoning model at a 512-token ceiling puts a 24-line book over the one-cent cap on the worst case alone. Five lines is what fits: worst case quoted $0.009696 against a $0.01 cap, actual list $0.009194.

Ceiling sized from the failure, not from hope. An earlier one-request probe at max_output_tokens=16 spent 13 tokens on thoughtsTokenCount and returned finishReason MAX_TOKENS with empty content — billed, no answer. At 512 the five jobs averaged 485 output tokens for a one-word answer, so even this ceiling was close to the wall: gemini-3.7-flash thinks hard about very little.
Thinking tokens are billed as output and are counted as output here. A receipt that read only candidatesTokenCount would have reported roughly a tenth of this bill.
